title: BuildPicks
description: Enhance your mining experience with the Emerald Pickaxe, a new tool tier between diamond and netherite. This mod also introduces two powerful treasure enchantments: Vein Miner, to clear 3x3 areas instantly, and Auto Smelt, to smelt ores as you mine them.
body:
# BuildPicks: 
is a focused mod designed to improve the mining and building aspects of Minecraft by introducing a new tool and two highly convenient enchantments.
## Key Features:

• **Emerald Pickaxe** A brand-new pickaxe crafted from emeralds. It serves as a new tool tier that is more efficient than diamond but not as powerful as netherite, giving you a valuable new use for your emeralds.

• **Vein Miner Enchantment** A rare treasure enchantment for pickaxes and shovels. When you mine a block, this enchantment instantly breaks a 3x3 area of identical, adjacent blocks. It is perfect for clearing large areas of stone or quickly excavating entire ore veins.

• **Auto Smelt Enchantment** A rare treasure enchantment for pickaxes. It automatically smelts raw ores (such as iron, gold, and ancient debris) into their smelted counterparts the moment you mine them. This saves you time and the resources you would otherwise spend on fuel.

• **Commands** Use the 
```
/buildpicks info
```
It's a command in-game to display the mod's version and author details.
The new enchantments can be obtained through loot chests, fishing, or villager trading, just like other treasure enchantments in the game.
